description: This source file defines the GatewayDeviceAuthPayload enum with methods for building authentication payloads, normalizing metadata fields, and creating signed device dictionaries for authentication purposes.

methods.name: buildV3
methods.description: Builds a version 3 authentication payload string with device info and scopes.

methods.name: normalizeMetadataField
methods.description: Normalizes optional string metadata fields by trimming and converting uppercase ASCII characters to lowercase.

methods.name: signedDeviceDictionary
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with signed device identity data, including public key and signature, for authentication.
